mapper.select: SELECT sms04_group_send_history_id AS history_id , sms04_company_id AS company_id , sms04_group_send_id AS group_send_id , TO_CHAR(sms04_send_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS send_date_str , sms04_target_nm AS target_name , sms04_target_tel_no AS target_tel_no FROM sms04_group_send_history WHERE sms04_group_send_id = #{groupSendId} AND sms04_company_id = #{companyId} AND UPPER(CONCAT(sms04_target_tel_no, sms04_target_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY sms04_send_date DESC, sms04_target_nm, sms04_target_tel_no
